lines.zh: 我贴着水面飘，光环先到一步。
lines.en: I drift near the surface, my halo arriving first.

lines.zh: 浅色的身体在水里几乎看不见。
lines.en: My pale body almost disappears in the water.

lines.zh: 月光照着我的光环，一圈一圈。
lines.en: Moonlight rings my halo, one circle after another.

lines.zh: 我不用鳍走，靠裙边一收一放。
lines.en: I don't walk on fins; my skirt ripples open and shut.

lines.zh: 往上游一点，海面就在上面。
lines.en: A little higher and the surface is right there.

lines.zh: 同族在前面，我跟着那点微光。
lines.en: Kin ahead; I follow that faint glow.

lines.zh: 四十格以上的海，水更凉。
lines.en: Above height forty the seawater runs colder.

lines.zh: 我游得慢，光环却转得快。
lines.en: I swim slowly, yet my halo turns quickly.

lines.zh: 别碰海草，我的触手会缠住。
lines.en: Mind the kelp; my arms get tangled in it.

lines.zh: 一圈光环照亮了身前半格。
lines.en: My halo lights the half block ahead of me.

lines.zh: 上弦月的夜里，我游得最稳。
lines.en: On first-quarter nights I swim steadiest.

lines.zh: 我侧过身，让水从裙边滑过去。
lines.en: I turn sideways and let water slip past my skirt.

lines.zh: 整片海只有我这一点亮。
lines.en: In this whole sea, only I am lit.

lines.zh: 往深处沉一点，光会变暗。
lines.en: Sink a little deeper and the glow dims.

lines.zh: 我收拢触手，从礁石下面穿过去。
lines.en: I draw in my arms and slip under the rock.

lines.zh: 我把光环压低，免得晃到自己。
lines.en: I dim my halo so it does not blind me.

lines.zh: 我随着潮水漂了一小段路。
lines.en: I drift a short way with the tide.

lines.zh: 我用裙边推水，慢慢转向。
lines.en: I push water with my skirt and turn slowly.

lines.zh: 我把触手收拢，像合起一把伞。
lines.en: I gather my arms like closing an umbrella.

lines.zh: 光环慢慢转，水也跟着转。
lines.en: My halo turns slowly, and the water turns with it.

lines.zh: 浅色的皮上，浮着几粒沙。
lines.en: A few grains of sand rest on my pale skin.

lines.zh: 只有六点血，我格外小心。
lines.en: Only six points of health, so I'm extra careful.

lines.zh: 水声很轻，我几乎听不见自己。
lines.en: The water is quiet; I can barely hear myself.

lines.zh: 我悬在原地，等月亮再偏一点。
lines.en: I hang here, waiting for the moon to shift.

lines.zh: 没人看见的时候，光环最亮。
lines.en: When no one's watching, my halo shines brightest.

lines.zh: 乌贼不赶路，路会自己过来。
lines.en: Cuttlefish don't hurry; the road comes to them.

lines.zh: 我把身体压扁，贴在海床上。
lines.en: I flatten myself against the seafloor.

lines.zh: 墨囊是空的，留着有急用。
lines.en: My ink sac is full, saved for an emergency.

lines.zh: 上弦月才过一半，我还有时间。
lines.en: The quarter moon is only halfway; I still have time.

lines.zh: 光在水里折成两道，挺好看。
lines.en: The glow folds into two lines underwater; pretty.

lines.zh: 我数着气泡，一个接一个。
lines.en: I count the bubbles, one after another.

lines.zh: 安静的海比吵闹的沙滩好。
lines.en: A quiet sea beats a noisy beach.

lines.zh: 你的头挡住了我的月光。
lines.en: Your head is blocking my moonlight.

lines.zh: 这么小的乌贼，值得你盯吗。
lines.en: Is such a small cuttlefish worth staring at?

lines.zh: 你眼睛里有光，像我的光环。
lines.en: There's light in your eyes, like my halo.

lines.zh: 我从没自然生成过，你该知道。
lines.en: I've never spawned naturally; you should know that.

lines.zh: 你手里的桶，我认得。
lines.en: I recognize that bucket in your hand.

lines.zh: 别用网兜，那会刮花我的皮。
lines.en: No nets, please; they scratch my pale skin.

lines.zh: 你看我的时候，光环转快了。
lines.en: My halo spins faster when you look at me.

lines.zh: 你退了半步，水纹就散了。
lines.en: You stepped back and the ripples broke apart.

lines.zh: 我这么浅的颜色，你也看得见。
lines.en: Even this pale, you still manage to see me.

lines.zh: 你钓我上来的那一晚，是上弦月。
lines.en: The night you fished me up was a quarter moon.

lines.zh: 我的皮薄，一碰就破。
lines.en: My skin is thin; it tears at a touch.

lines.zh: 光环被撞歪了，我扶不正。
lines.en: My halo is knocked crooked and won't straighten.

lines.zh: 六点血，这一下就没了一半。
lines.en: Six health, and that blow took half of it.

lines.zh: 别打了，我又不咬人。
lines.en: Stop hitting; I don't even bite people.

lines.zh: 墨汁喷出去，我先走了。
lines.en: I jet ink and slip away first.

lines.zh: 光环暗了一圈，我下沉。
lines.en: My halo dims a ring; I sink.

lines.zh: 这一下把我从水里掀起来。
lines.en: That blow lifted me right out of the water.

lines.zh: 我躲进石缝，血流得很慢。
lines.en: I hide in a crevice; the blood runs slowly.

lines.zh: 疼是疼，可我还能游。
lines.en: It hurts, but I can still swim.

lines.zh: 你们打一条乌贼，也不嫌累。
lines.en: Hitting a cuttlefish all day must be tiring.

lines.zh: 鱼钩上的虾，味道很近。
lines.en: That shrimp on the hook smells very close.

lines.zh: 我本来不该咬，可光环发烫。
lines.en: I shouldn't bite, but my halo feels hot.

lines.zh: 你把线放低，我就靠近一点。
lines.en: Lower the line and I'll come a little closer.

lines.zh: 我这体型，一口就吞得下。
lines.en: Small as I am, I can swallow it in one go.

lines.zh: 上钩之后我游得比平常快。
lines.en: Once hooked I swim faster than usual.

lines.zh: 拉力零点八二，你别太用力。
lines.en: A pull of zero point eight two; don't yank.

lines.zh: 我没有别的来路，只能被钓。
lines.en: I have no other way here; only the hook.

lines.zh: 月亮看着呢，我不好意思咬。
lines.en: The moon is watching; I'm embarrassed to bite.

lines.zh: 再晃一下，我就管不住触手了。
lines.en: One more wiggle and my arms lose control.

lines.zh: 你钓到我很不容易，别松线。
lines.en: Catching me is rare; don't loosen the line.

lines.zh: 我撞上你了，光环晃了一下。
lines.en: I bumped you and my halo wobbled.

lines.zh: 对不起，我只有零点八格宽。
lines.en: Sorry; I'm only zero point eight wide.

lines.zh: 你的膝盖撞散了我身边的水纹。
lines.en: Your knee broke the ripples around me.

lines.zh: 轻一点，我的身体很薄。
lines.en: Careful; my body is very thin.

lines.zh: 这一下把我推得转了半圈。
lines.en: That shove spun me half a turn.

lines.zh: 我贴着你滑过去，没伤到吧。
lines.en: I slid past you; are you hurt?

lines.zh: 别用手抓，触手会断。
lines.en: Don't grab; my arms can snap.

lines.zh: 水被挤开，光环也歪了。
lines.en: The water squeezed aside and my halo tilted.

lines.zh: 你退开时，我才敢浮上来。
lines.en: I only surfaced after you stepped away.

lines.zh: 两具身体撞在一起，谁都没事。
lines.en: Two bodies knocked together; neither is worse.

lines.zh: 同族之间，光环会对上节奏。
lines.en: Among kin, our halos find the same rhythm.

lines.zh: 你也有一圈光，跟我转吧。
lines.en: You have a ring too; turn it with mine.

lines.zh: 上弦月的夜，适合靠近一点。
lines.en: On a quarter-moon night it's good to be near.

lines.zh: 我跟着你的光游，不会撞上。
lines.en: I'll swim by your light and not collide.

lines.zh: 两条乌贼并排，海水亮了。
lines.en: Two cuttlefish side by side brighten the water.

lines.zh: 别急，先把触手轻轻搭上。
lines.en: Easy; lay your arms gently first.

lines.zh: 受惊时我们会散，这次别散。
lines.en: We scatter when startled; not this time.

lines.zh: 你比我大一点，光也更稳。
lines.en: You're a bit larger, and your light steadier.

lines.zh: 这段海沟，够我们并排游。
lines.en: This trench is wide enough for us both.

lines.zh: 月落之前，我们都不走。
lines.en: Before the moon sets, neither of us leaves.

lines.zh: 我用触手卷住这条鱼。
lines.en: I curl an arm around this fish.

lines.zh: 桶里水浅，但比我原来的海暖。
lines.en: The bucket's shallow, but warmer than my sea.

lines.zh: 掉了东西，我先用光看看。
lines.en: Something dropped; let me light it first.

lines.zh: 我拿不稳，触手太软。
lines.en: I can't hold it; my arms are too soft.

lines.zh: 鱼从指缝滑下去，又落回海床。
lines.en: The fish slips through and falls to the seabed.

lines.zh: 你在桶里加了水，我放心了。
lines.en: You filled the bucket; now I relax.

lines.zh: 这么小一条，我得分两口。
lines.en: Such a small fish; I'll eat it in two bites.

lines.zh: 别把桶摇来摇去，光环会晕。
lines.en: Don't slosh the bucket; my halo spins.

lines.zh: 我卷起一块贝壳，不是食物。
lines.en: I picked up a shell; it isn't food.

lines.zh: 搬动我时轻些，我只有六点血。
lines.en: Move me gently; I have only six health.

lines.zh: 水里有个影子，比虾大。
lines.en: There's a shadow in the water, bigger than shrimp.

lines.zh: 光环照到它了，它没动。
lines.en: My halo found it and it didn't move.

lines.zh: 那东西在沉，正好顺路。
lines.en: It's sinking; convenient for me.

lines.zh: 我是猎手，只是不太快。
lines.en: I am a hunter, just not a fast one.

lines.zh: 先靠近半格，别惊动水。
lines.en: Half a block closer without stirring the water.

lines.zh: 它的壳朝下，软的地方露着。
lines.en: Its shell faces down; the soft part shows.

lines.zh: 我闻到了，很淡，但够了。
lines.en: I caught the scent; faint, but enough.

lines.zh: 这条鱼比我还小，也能吃。
lines.en: This fish is smaller than me, but edible.

lines.zh: 把光收一收，别照到它。
lines.en: Dim the light so it doesn't catch it.

lines.zh: 时机到了，我慢慢靠过去。
lines.en: The moment's here; I drift in slowly.

lines.zh: 我盯着它，光环一动不动。
lines.en: I fix on it and my halo goes still.

lines.zh: 它若是转身，我就退回暗处。
lines.en: If it turns, I'll slip back into the dark.

lines.zh: 我的触手已经张开，等着。
lines.en: My arms are spread and waiting.

lines.zh: 它在动，我的光跟着偏。
lines.en: It moves, and my light drifts with it.

lines.zh: 六点血不能硬拼，得等。
lines.en: Six health can't brawl; I have to wait.

lines.zh: 它离海床只有一指高。
lines.en: It's only a finger above the seabed.

lines.zh: 水纹很平，它还没发现。
lines.en: The ripples are flat; it hasn't noticed.

lines.zh: 我把身体压暗，慢慢贴上去。
lines.en: I dim my body and press in closer.

lines.zh: 再近一点，触手就够得着。
lines.en: A little closer and my arms can reach.

lines.zh: 别呼吸太重，会惊到它。
lines.en: Breathe gently or it will startle.

lines.zh: 我用触手缠住它，再收拢。
lines.en: I wrap my arms around it and pull tight.

lines.zh: 这一口不大，但它挣不开。
lines.en: It's a small bite, but it can't get free.

lines.zh: 光环晃了一下，我用力过猛。
lines.en: My halo jolted; I struck too hard.

lines.zh: 墨汁喷出去，水一下浑了。
lines.en: I jet ink and the water goes cloudy.

lines.zh: 我只有这么点力气，别笑。
lines.en: This is all the strength I have; don't laugh.

lines.zh: 它甩开我，触手上留了印。
lines.en: It threw me off; my arm is marked.

lines.zh: 咬住就别松，这是规矩。
lines.en: Once I bite, I hold; that's the rule.

lines.zh: 打完我得躲进珊瑚缝里。
lines.en: After the fight I'll hide in a coral crack.

lines.zh: 这么小的猎物，也费了我半天。
lines.en: Even prey this small costs me half a day.

lines.zh: 我的牙不尖，靠的是缠。
lines.en: My beak isn't sharp; I rely on gripping.

lines.zh: 我是被钓上来的，不是生出来的。
lines.en: I was reeled in, not spawned.

lines.zh: 上弦月的海面，我第一次露头。
lines.en: On a quarter-moon sea I first showed my head.

lines.zh: 光圈先亮，身体才跟上。
lines.en: The ring lights first; my body follows.

lines.zh: 这片海很静，适合我。
lines.en: This sea is quiet; it suits me.

lines.zh: 别围，我只有六点血。
lines.en: Don't crowd me; I have six health.

lines.zh: 水从裙边灌进来，我展开了。
lines.en: Water fills my skirt and I unfold.

lines.zh: 我从鱼线尽头掉进这片海。
lines.en: I dropped from a line's end into this sea.

lines.zh: 非常稀有的那种，就是我。
lines.en: The very rare kind — that's me.

lines.zh: 一出现就有人在看，真不习惯。
lines.en: Being watched the moment I appear is strange.

lines.zh: 月亮还在，我慢慢漂起来。
lines.en: The moon is still up; I drift slowly.

lines.zh: 烤过的鱼味，让我想起熟鱼。
lines.en: That roasted smell reminds me of cooked fish.

lines.zh: 我从水面摔到海床，光环裂了。
lines.en: I fell from the surface to the seabed; my halo cracked.

lines.zh: 我泡在水里，却喘不上气。
lines.en: I'm in water, yet I can't catch my breath.

lines.zh: 冲击把我推出去好远。
lines.en: The blast threw me a long way off.

lines.zh: 一支箭穿过光环，扎进肉里。
lines.en: An arrow pierced my halo and sank in.

lines.zh: 紫光缠上来，我的光被压住。
lines.en: Purple light coils around me and presses my glow down.

lines.zh: 海里的小虾越来越少了。
lines.en: The little shrimp in this sea are running out.

lines.zh: 雷劈进海里，我全身发麻。
lines.en: Lightning struck the sea and numbed me all over.

lines.zh: 这里连水都没有，我怎么游。
lines.en: There isn't even water here; how do I swim?
